result.instruction: In `counter8_core`, replace `count_reg + 1'b1` with per-bit toggle equations: bit 0 toggles on `enable`, and each higher bit toggles on `enable` AND the reduction-AND of all lower count bits. Keep the synchronous active-high reset at highest priority, hold every bit when disabled, and preserve the registered 8-bit output and modulo wraparound. Keep `counter8`, its ports, and its `// @latency 1` annotation unchanged; evaluate only the complete unit through the fixed integration flow.
